title: Wizardsbane Oil Recipe
summary: Recipe for the coating that disrupts spellcasting.

fields.Recipe: Extract 3 Gremishka Tails into Essence of Gremishka Tail. Combine the Essence with any Suspension to create Wizardsbane Oil.
fields.Availability: The pinned recipe page does not identify a confirmed copy location.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
